name: CIVNFT unvalidated mint callback
summary: CIVNFT accepted an attacker contract as a purported Uniswap V3 pool, then trusted its mint callback and token-address responses. Nine calls used victims' existing allowances to transfer five assets from their wallets to the fake pool.
notes: The second and final Upgraded event before the campaign selected implementation 0x78bd317a87d2eab65b666e9402182a949ab4eeb9, whose callback logic all nine exploit transactions executed.

Exact gross transfers from nine victim wallets to the attacker helper across the nine defect-executing transactions. USDC is valued at par; the other assets use historical DefiLlama observations before the attacker began disposing of them. The seed row's $180,000 estimate is replaced because it is not reproduced by the onchain asset quantities and contemporaneous prices. Later transfers from the helper to the attacker EOA and swaps are movements or disposal of the same stolen assets and are not counted again.
